parameters.description: Specifies the extended key usage. The values in the hash table define the certificate's intended purpose.

parameters.name: EnrollmentRenewThresholdPct
parameters.description: Specifies the percentage of the certificate lifetime that remains before the device requests renewal of the certificate.

parameters.name: EnrollmentRetryCount
parameters.description: Specifies the number of times that the device automatically retries the certificate request to the server that is running the Network Device Enrollment Service.

parameters.name: EnrollmentRetryDelayMins
parameters.description: Specifies the interval, in minutes, between each enrollment attempt when you use CA manager approval before the issuing CA processes the certificate request.

parameters.description: Specifies the Key Storage Provider (KSP) for the SCEP enrollment. Valid values are: - None - InstallToTPM_FailIfNotPresent - InstallToTPM_IfPresent - InstallToSoftwareKeyStorageProvider - InstallToNGC_FailIfNotPresent

parameters.name: RootCertificate
parameters.description: Specifies a trusted root CA certificate object. To get a trusted root CA certificate, use the Get-CMCertificateProfileTrustedRootCA function.

parameters.name: SanType
parameters.description: Specifies one or more subject alternative name. Valid values are: - SubjectAltRequireSpn - SubjectAltRequireUpn - SubjectAltReqiureEmail - SubjectAltRequireDns

parameters.name: ScepServerUrl
parameters.description: Specifies an array of URLs for the Network Device Enrollment Service (NDES) servers that will issue certificates via SCEP.
